name: Crossbow Training
text: **Crossbow Training**: Mordant Spire elves train with weapons that can be used underwater. An elf with this trait can reload a light crossbow as a free action and a heavy crossbow as a move action, provided that she is proficient with the weapon. If she selects the Rapid Reload feat for a heavy crossbow, she can reload the weapon as a free action. This racial trait replaces weapon familiarity.
